result_semantics.rule: No dimension promotes another dimension. Positive action admission requires every use-case-required dimension to be independently satisfied.
result_semantics.adaptive_query_policy: Repeated/adaptive predicates are an information-flow channel; query-sequence admission is domain-policy-owned, purpose/audience scoped, and consent bound. Unknown history or incomplete policy coverage is indeterminate; do not infer a fresh allowance.

claims.proposition: The proof request is canonical and bound to one audience, purpose, predicate, policy, target and intended effect.
The authenticated proof envelope has canonical structure and supported protocol/domain versions.
The exact envelope transcript was signed by the expected envelope signer.
The private claim is tied to an authenticated source statement from an issuer authorized for this claim and scope.
The hidden witness satisfies the exact public predicate and produces the exact public output.
The proof was verified against the independently expected program/AIR/image identity.
The verifier issued a fresh challenge bound to this request and audience, and it was consumed at most once.
Credential validity, revocation and applicable source frontier satisfy the domain profile at the relevant cutoff.
The exact policy and authority generation are applicable to this subject, purpose, jurisdiction and request.
The operator and host are authenticated and the session capability permits the requested interaction lane.
The authorized participant approved this exact request, purpose, recipient and scope, and consent is not revoked.
The domain-owned governance and policy mechanism authorizes this exact action for this subject and context.
A single-use capability authorizes only the exact action and is current at effect commit.
The attempt has one reconciled terminal outcome; unknown outcomes are not retried blindly.
The stated effect is supported by evidence whose proposition, coverage, source relationship and time are explicit.
Material dependency changes invalidate exactly the affected claims while preserving historical evidence and unrelated claims.
The exact Symthaea verification receipt was attested by an enrolled Xenia signer/daemon under the expected typed scope and live authority state.
claims.non_equivalence: Xenia attestation authenticates who attested to the exact Symthaea receipt; it does not prove the underlying claim, evidence admission, institutional authority or effect.

claims.proposition: The predicate family, resolution, purpose, audience and repeated-query sequence are permitted under the applicable policy and consent scope.
Credential status validation does not reveal an unauthorized correlation between holder, verifier, issuer and interaction time.
Each cryptographic layer meets the exact policy-required algorithm and security profile without downgrade or cross-layer capability inheritance.
Cryptographic authentication establishes the exact recorded consent attestation and scope, but does not imply comprehension, legal capacity, free choice or absence of coercion.
claims.non_equivalence: Authenticated consent receipt != proven informed or uncoerced consent.

claims.proposition: Consent revocation blocks future authority under its scope but does not imply deletion of data already disclosed to a recipient.

existing_blockers.concern: Selective-disclosure path must not equate non-empty proof bytes and commitment length with proof validity.
Cross-DID proof verification, verifier-issued challenge and replay semantics.
Authenticated qualification receipt semantics; receipt authentication is not application authority.
LISE claim-specific invalidation and targeted requalification oracle.
Stale decision must not become effect authority at commit.
Formal refinement of the RISC Zero balance guest relation and public journal.
PEC planner must consume qualified Mycelix semantics and return NoQualifiedPlan where necessary.
HDC semantics and Binius integrity-versus-privacy claim correction; PR remains separate from this Mycelix profile.
Session capability must mediate every privileged lane and revocation/reconnect race.
Issuer-attested, source-bound and verifier-request-bound private balance claim; new issue extending #5842 without widening its relation-refinement theorem.
HealthRangeAir is underconstrained; quarantined from eligibility and authorization until replacement AIR theorem and malicious-witness tests qualify.
Other Winterfell AIRs share possible verifier-theorem gaps; use umbrella census and per-circuit owners.
Winterfell AIR soundness does not imply witness privacy; do not label the current STARK profile zero-knowledge.
Candidate proof options are not a measured production security level; pin and measure exact proof security profile.
Malformed proof trace dimensions must be rejected without verifier process panic.
Exact vendored Binius64/Iron Spartan source and witness-hiding repair must be independently qualified before HDC witness-privacy claims.
Consent presentation/process evidence and revocation/retention boundary; do not overclaim comprehension or coercion resistance from cryptographic authentication.

action substitution after consent or capability issue
authority/policy/revocation change between decision and effect commit
unknown effect, incomplete observation or incomplete dependency/change feed

Symthaea receipt ID or canonical receipt digest substituted in portable Xenia authority receipt
mixed or non-enrolled hybrid signing keys, wrong typed scope or daemon host fingerprint
expired portable authority receipt, duplicate nonce, same nonce with changed receipt binding
daemon restart after durable reservation but before receipt retention; DeliveryUnknown must not mint again
unapproved adaptive threshold/predicate sequence can infer hidden value despite valid ZK proofs
incomplete query-history or policy frontier must not be treated as a fresh predicate allowance
credential-specific status URL/global status index exposes holder-verifier-time correlation

authenticated consent receipt does not prove comprehension, legal capacity, free choice or absence of coercion
consent revocation blocks future use but does not prove previously disclosed data was erased

nonclaims: No proof backend or cryptographic relation is qualified by this matrix.
No scenario has been executed or independently adjudicated.
No privacy, unlinkability, issuer truth, institutional authority or external-effect claim is established.
This matrix is not a runtime schema or authorization input.
